title: Integer semantics and casts
why: Narrowing/widening casts, sign extension, shifts (arithmetic vs logical) and division rounding are classic differential-testing targets; solang implements its own IR lowering for these.
hints: Shift negative ints: int8(-8) >> 1 (arithmetic) vs uint8(248) >> 1 (logical).
Signed division/modulo rounding toward zero vs floor: -7 / 2, -7 % 2.
Cast chains: int16 -> uint8 -> int64 with values that flip sign.
Byte-level access on bytesN and explicit bytesN<->uint casts.
unchecked { } blocks vs default checked arithmetic edge values (type(uintN).max).
